decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted HEA07-U912-100, HEA07-U912-110, HEA07-U912-120, HEA07-U912-130, HEA07-U912-140, HEA07-U912-150, HEA07-U912-160, HEA07-U912-170, HEA07-U912-180, HEA07-U912-200, HEA07-UD12-201, HEA07-U912-300, HEA07-U912-301, HEA07-U912-400, HEA-U912-401, HEA07-U912-500, HEA07-U912-501 (received 14/01/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Parking to be provided as specified in the application prior to the occupation of the proposed mezzanine and retained in that form for as long as the development remains in existence.

Condition : 4 - Cycle shelter to be provided as specified in the application proposed prior to the occupation of the proposed mezzanine and retained in that form for as long as the development remains in existence.
description: Installation of new loading shutter door to the front elevation of unit 10, erection of new additional mezzaine floor in unit 12 for warehouse and office use and restructuring of car parking layout.
